title: Verdant 43 — Snowbound: the Winter Twin of Verdant 09 Town, Tile for Tile, for RPG Maker MZ, Tiled & Godot [16x16]
shortText: Verdant 09 Town under snow, tile for tile: 510 tiles at the same positions, so a map swaps to winter. MZ, Tiled, Godot.
description:
The winter twin of Verdant 09 — Town, tile for tile. 510 tiles at 16x16 in one 78-colour palette: the same town under snow, every tile at the same position in the same sheet as its summer twin. Commercial use permitted in unlimited projects, no attribution required; you may not resell the tiles themselves as an asset pack.

Swap the season, keep the map

Every one of the 510 tiles in Verdant 09 Town has a twin here with the same name, sheet and position, checked file by file against Verdant 09's shipped tiles.json, RPG Maker MZ sheets, Tiled tilesets and Godot TileSet. So a map you built with Verdant 09 turns to winter by swapping the tileset: in RPG Maker MZ with the Change Tileset event command or a second Tileset in the Database, in Tiled by repointing the tilesets, in Godot by loading this TileSet. The positions are proven identical file by file; the swap itself was not run inside the MZ editor. The GIF above is Verdant 09's own sample map, swapped.

What is in it

  • 376 transition tiles in 8 complete 47-mask sets: the trodden street and the gardens cut into the snowy common, snow on the hedges, the timber-framed walls on their plinths, and both roofs under snow, the thatch with a blue shadowed eave and the shingles with a snow band on every course.
  • 28 fill tiles: the common under fresh snow, the street with its joints packed and some stones snowed over, the gardens with the clods breaking through, the hedge, the wall (a wall does not hold snow, so it is Verdant 09's own) and both roofs.
  • All 37 Verdant 09 objects under snow, from the market stalls and cross to doors, windows, signs and garden rows: snow is laid inside each object's own outline, so every object is exactly the size of its summer twin. Each ships transparent and grounded, with contact shadows re-derived for snow.
  • 24 animated tiles: the wall lantern, the smoking chimney and the bunting, 4 frames each, under snow.
  • A finished 26x18 sample map: Verdant 09's own map in winter, as PNG, JSON and a Tiled .tmx.

Engines

  • RPG Maker MZ: every set on the A2 sheet as MZ's own autotile brush; every shape was composed back out of the sheet with MZ's own autotile table (384 of 384 identical). Tested against the table, not inside the MZ editor. Objects on the B, C and D sheets.
  • Tiled: one .tsx per sheet; Tiled's own renderer drew the sample map identical to ours (479,232 px, 0 differ).
  • Godot 4: one TileSet, loaded and verified in Godot 4.7.2 (510 tiles built).

The proofs

Every tile's wrap boundary is measured against its own interior, and every 4x4 repetition is rendered and reviewed. Grid, palette and autotile completeness are machine-proven: every tile is exactly 16x16, every pixel is inside the 78-colour palette, and alpha is strictly on or off. The snow on the common is Verdant 03's own, byte for byte.

More from the series

Verdant 09 — Town is the same town in summer, and Verdant 41 — Taiga is the snowy forest beyond it.

AI disclosure

Every tile is generated by our own procedural drawing engine, which is AI-written software. No image model, no scraped art and no training dataset were used, and nothing was traced.
